_howTo: Home page announcement. Between showFrom and showUntil (YYYY-MM-DD, both days included) the announcement takes English Stars' place at the top of the home page, and English Stars becomes a thin line above it. Outside those dates, English Stars shows as normal. To turn it off early, set showUntil to yesterday.
